shots.name: chat
shots.prompt: A handsome Nigerian man in his thirties in a crisp shirt sits on the stairs of his duplex in a gated estate, frowning at a busy group chat on his phone. Evening light. Phone screen facing away.

shots.name: aerial
shots.prompt: Aerial drone photograph over a beautiful gated residential estate in Lekki, Lagos at golden hour: rows of white and cream duplexes with grey roofs, palms, interlocking paved streets, a gatehouse at the entrance, water tanks on stands.

shots.name: pay
shots.prompt: A stylish Nigerian woman in her thirties sits at her kitchen island in a gated estate home, smiling as she completes a payment on her phone. Morning light, plants. Phone screen facing away.

shots.name: gate
shots.prompt: A handsome, well-groomed Nigerian estate security guard in his thirties, crisp navy uniform and cap, smiles and waves a car through the raised barrier at the gatehouse of a smart estate. Golden late-afternoon light.

shots.name: agm
shots.prompt: A relaxed annual general meeting of a Nigerian estate residents' association in a bright clubhouse: twenty well-dressed residents of mixed ages seated in rows, a woman treasurer presenting a clear chart on a screen, people nodding. Daylight. Screen content not readable.

shots.name: why
shots.prompt: A distinguished, well-groomed Nigerian couple in their fifties sit together on the veranda of their duplex in a gated estate, smiling and at ease with tea, late afternoon light, palms and paving behind them.
